title: Castelion button
description: A square-cornered signal-red slab, 56px tall, with a semibold label spaced wide. On hover it either turns navy (solid) or flips to the text colour with a navy label and outline (invert, for navy bands), over half a second.
notes: set its width from outside (w-full, w-80…)
name: castelion-button

props.name: variant
props.description: solid: red → navy on hover · invert: red → text colour with a navy label and outline (on navy bands)
